## Dataset and licence review

- [ ] Dataset source, licence, citation, access, and redistribution conditions are documented.
- [ ] Synthetic and real-data results are clearly separated.
- [ ] Sample identity and the independent split unit are explicit.
- [ ] Duplicate, near-duplicate, augmented, correlated-session, source-file, and temporal leakage risks were checked.

## Experiment review

- [ ] Preprocessing is fitted only on allowed data and is replayable.
- [ ] Test data was not used for tuning, calibration fitting, early stopping, or checkpoint selection.
- [ ] Class mapping, seeds, split manifest, model configuration, and environment are recorded.
- [ ] Classical baseline comparison remains available before or alongside a neural model.
- [ ] Multiple-run variability and calibration limitations are reported where relevant.
- [ ] No operational radar, defence, safety, or real-world generalisation claim is unsupported.
